purpose: Phase-5C GENE-REGULATION / TRANSCRIPTION registry. Maps signaling transcription-factor NODES (from the frozen 5B.1/5B.2 signal graph) to schematic promoter response-elements, genes, and mRNA - the first biological response downstream of signaling. Consumed READ-ONLY by transcriptionEngine.js. STOPS AT mRNA: no translation/ribosomes/proteins/enzymes/metabolism/apoptosis/PD/PK. The frozen Profile-B package contains NO direct transcription data, so gene regulation here is mostly PREDICTED and clearly labelled; nothing is EXPERIMENTAL unless a real experimental reference is attached (none is). No DOI / fold-change / transcription-rate / RNA-copy-number is fabricated.
integrity_note: Chen 2012 -> target NOT_REPORTED (5A) -> signaling partly predicted (5B) -> gene regulation mostly predicted (5C). This hierarchy is intact: TFs inherit their activity from the signaling nodes (Nrf2, NF-kB) which are exposure-driven predictions; the TF->promoter->gene->mRNA relationships are canonical general biology applied to this context (MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION) or drug-class literature (LITERATURE_DERIVED_PREDICTION). Mouse and rat have NO transcription-factor node in the signal graph and NO transcription evidence -> NOT_REPORTED (empty), never transferred from human.

tf_nrf2.name: Nrf2
tf_nrf2.rationale: Nrf2 nuclear translocation + ARE binding is canonical redox biology applied to this exposure-driven HaCaT context; not measured in the frozen package.

tf_nfkb.name: NF-kB
tf_nfkb.rationale: NF-kB nuclear translocation + response-element binding is canonical; here NF-kB is drug-SUPPRESSED (5B-H2), so its transcriptional drive falls. Not measured in the frozen package.

binding_tfs.note: Nrf2/NF-kB cross-talk repression is described generally; hypothesis in this context.

g_hmox1.rationale: HMOX1 is the canonical Nrf2/ARE target; celastrol-driven HO-1 induction is described in the literature but not in the frozen Profile-B package (unverified in repo).

g_nqo1.rationale: NQO1 is a canonical Nrf2/ARE target (one TF -> multiple genes / branching); mechanistic prediction in this context, not in the frozen package.

g_infl.rationale: Schematic NF-kB-driven inflammatory gene: activated by NF-kB, repressed by Nrf2 cross-talk (multiple TFs / competition). Drug suppresses NF-kB (5B-H2) so net expression falls. No specific gene identity or value claimed.

mouse_b16bl6.reason: The mouse melanoma signal graph (5B-M1: PI3K/AKT/mTOR -> survival output) contains NO transcription-factor node, and no transcription evidence exists in the frozen package. Gene regulation is NOT REPORTED; no human transcription profile is transferred to mouse.

rat_skin.reason: Rat has no cellular signaling profile (5B-R1 NOT REPORTED) and no transcription evidence. Gene regulation is NOT REPORTED; nothing is transferred from human or mouse.

provenance_sources: simulator/data/signal-*.registry.json + signal-propagation.registry.json (5B, read-only) - TF activity source
TF->promoter->gene->mRNA relationships are canonical general biology / drug-class literature applied to this context; labelled predictions, no fabricated citation or value.
